description: This file defines the LeaveEntitlementModel class, which models leave entitlement data within the OrangeHRM leave management plugin. It implements serialization for API responses by configuring entity filters and attribute mappings, encapsulating LeaveEntitlement entity data including employee info, leave type, dates, and entitlement details.

classes.name: LeaveEntitlementModel
classes.description: A model class for serializing LeaveEntitlement entity data into API responses, including employee details, leave type, dates, and entitlement attributes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with a LeaveEntitlement entity and sets up filters and attribute mappings for serialization.
